poruthams.name: Dina Porutham
poruthams.significance: Health, longevity & freedom from physical afflictions (க்ஷேமமாக இருத்தல்)
poruthams.rule: Dina count is 17 (Inauspicious Tarabalam).

poruthams.name: Gana Porutham
poruthams.significance: Temperament, mental peace & mutual affection (செல்வத்துடன் இருத்தல் / அன்யோன்ய வசியம்)
poruthams.rule: Girl Rakshasa Gana Dosha is cancelled because Boy star is > 14 stars away (17 stars).

poruthams.name: Mahendra Porutham
poruthams.significance: Longevity of progeny & family lineage growth (ஆயுள் விருத்தி & சந்தான விருத்தி)
poruthams.rule: Count 17 does not fall in Mahendra series (1, 4, 7, 10, 13, 16, 19, 22, 25).

poruthams.name: Stree Deergham
poruthams.significance: Longevity, prosperity & continuous well-being of the bride (மணப்பெண் ஆயுள் & தாம்பத்ய சௌக்கியம்)
poruthams.rule: Distance is 17 stars (> 13 stars) - Uttama Deergham for Bride.

poruthams.name: Yoni Porutham
poruthams.significance: Physical, biological & intimate mutual harmony (அன்யோன்ய வசியம் & தேக சௌக்கியம்)
poruthams.rule: Different friendly Yonis (Rat & Mongoose) - Compatible.

poruthams.name: Rasi Porutham
poruthams.significance: Family welfare, prosperity & lineage growth (வம்ச விருத்தி & மன ஒற்றுமை)
poruthams.rule: Shashtashtakam (6-8 distance) - Inauspicious unless remedial propitiations performed.

poruthams.name: Rasi Adhipathi Porutham
poruthams.significance: Parental friendship, intellectual bonding & planetary accord (சம்பந்திகள் நட்பு & கிரக அனுகூலம்)
poruthams.rule: Planetary enmity exists between Sun and Saturn.

poruthams.name: Vashya Porutham
poruthams.significance: Mutual magnetic attraction & devoted marital affection (ஒருவருக்கொருவர் வசியமாக இருத்தல்)
poruthams.rule: No direct Vashya attraction between Makara and Simha.

poruthams.name: Rajju Porutham
poruthams.significance: Mangalya Bhagyam & long wedded life (தீர்க்க சுமங்கலியாயிருத்தல் - தலையாய பொருத்தம்)
poruthams.rule: Different Rajjus (Groom: Pada, Bride: Udara) - Auspicious! (ரஜ்ஜு தோஷமில்லை).

poruthams.name: Vedha Porutham
poruthams.significance: Absence of mutual repulsion, sorrow & occult affliction (தம்பதிகள் சௌக்கியம்)
poruthams.rule: No Vedha affliction between Magha and Uttara Ashadha (வேதை தோஷமில்லை).

poruthams.name: Nadi Porutham
poruthams.significance: Genetic vitality, bloodline & physiological health (நாடிப் பொருத்தம் / ஆரோக்கியம்)
poruthams.rule: Both have Vama Nadi (தக்ஷிண/வாம பார்சுவ நாடி) - Threatens health of Groom.

poruthams.name: Vriksha Porutham

poruthams.rule: Both trees are milky trees (பால் உள்ள மரங்கள்: ஆல் & பலா) - Highly auspicious.

appointments.clientQuery: I am facing career stagnancy and delays in promotion despite strong appraisal. Will changing jobs after the next solar transit be auspicious or should I stay in current firm?
appointments.astrologerAnswer: Detailed examination of your 10th house (Karma Bhava) and Sun transit shows that Saturn aspect is causing a temporary delay until mid-December. Post 14th December, Sun enters Sagittarius which activates your 5th and 9th house trikona. It is highly recommended to wait until mid-December before accepting external offers; a promotion or favorable salary revision in your current organization is strongly indicated.
appointments.prescribedRemedies:
1. Chant Aditya Hridaya Stotra every Sunday morning during Surya Hora.
2. Offer water (Arghya) with red kumkum and akshat to rising Sun.
3. Wear a genuine 5-Mukhi Nepali Rudraksha in silver casing.
4. Avoid signing major employment contracts during Rahu Kalam hours.

appointments.clientQuery: Review of Ashtakoota compatibility with Pooja Iyer, specifically addressing Nadi Dosha mitigation and auspicious Vivaha Muhurat dates for early 2027.
We are constructing a new north-facing residential home in Varanasi. I want to check the kitchen placement in Southeast vs Northwest and recommended puja for Griha Pravesh.
appointments.astrologerAnswer: According to classical Vastu Shastra (Mayamatam), the Southeast (Agneya kona) is ruled by Agni Deva and is the strictly auspicious quadrant for the kitchen and cooking hearth. Northwest (Vayavya) should only be used as a secondary alternative if plumbing constraints arise. The cooking platform must face East so the cook faces sunrise.
appointments.prescribedRemedies:
1. Perform Vastu Shanti Homam and Navagraha Havan on Shukla Trayodashi before Griha Pravesh.
2. Bury a small energized Copper Swastika and Vastu Yantra at Northeast (Ishanya) corner foundation.
3. Conduct Go-Pooja (Cow & Calf worship) during the Griha Pravesh Brahma Muhurat.
